title: After a refinement with final: yes, a later refinement must not change the view
rule: final: yes on a refinement stops any later refinement of the same view from applying.

citations.quote: The Looker IDE will return a LookML error if there are existing refinements that would be applied after this final refinement

rationale: Looker rejects the project with a LookML error. A tool may report an error, but must not resolve the view with the later refinement applied.
